title: Exodus Bible Quiz - Chapter 24
description: Ten questions on Exodus 24: the covenant is confirmed with blood, the elders see the God of Israel, and Moses goes up into the cloud.

questions.text: Besides Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, who was called to come up and worship from a distance?
questions.explanation: Moses was to come up with Aaron, Nadab, Abihu and seventy of the elders of Israel, and they were to worship from a distance.

answers.text: The twelve heads of the tribes
Seventy of the elders of Israel
All the sons of Levi in the camp

questions.text: How did the people answer when Moses told them all Yahweh's words?
questions.explanation: All the people answered with one voice: "All the words which Yahweh has spoken will we do."

answers.text: With one voice they said they would do all of it
They asked for time to think it over
They said they would keep only part of it

questions.text: What did Moses build at the base of the mountain together with the altar?
questions.explanation: Moses built an altar at the base of the mountain with twelve pillars for the twelve tribes of Israel.

answers.text: A bronze basin for washing the priests
A tent of meeting for the elders
Seven steps of uncut stone up to the altar
Twelve pillars for the twelve tribes

questions.text: Moses put half of the blood in basins. What did he do with the other half?
questions.explanation: Moses put half of the blood in basins, and the other half he sprinkled on the altar.

answers.text: He poured it on the ground
He sprinkled it on the altar
He put it on the pillars
He burned it with the fat

questions.text: What did Moses read in the hearing of the people?
questions.explanation: Moses took the book of the covenant and read it in the hearing of the people.

answers.text: The book of the wars of Yahweh

questions.text: What was under the feet of the God of Israel like?
questions.explanation: Under his feet was like a paved work of sapphire stone, like the skies for clearness.

answers.text: A paved work of sapphire stone

questions.text: What did the nobles of Israel do after they saw God?
questions.explanation: God did not lay his hand on the nobles of Israel. They saw God, and ate and drank.

answers.text: They hid their faces in the rock
They ran back to the camp

questions.text: Who is called Moses' servant in verse 13?
questions.explanation: Verse 13 says Moses rose up with Joshua, his servant, and went up onto God's Mountain.

questions.text: Whom did Moses leave with the elders to handle disputes?
questions.explanation: Moses told the elders that Aaron and Hur were with them, and whoever had a dispute could go to them.

questions.text: How long was Moses on the mountain after he entered the cloud?
questions.explanation: Moses entered into the middle of the cloud and was on the mountain forty days and forty nights.
